Grass type, sunlight, moisture, and weeds help guide treatment. Tell us about thin areas, patches, or places that stay wet so we can consider what is holding the lawn back.
Our liquid program pairs seasonal nutrition with weed prevention and targeted control. Products and timing are selected for the grass, active problems, and application conditions.
We review the lawn’s response and monitor insect and disease concerns as the seasons change. Visit photos and notes explain the work and any watering, mowing, or other aftercare.
Care through South Louisiana’s seasons
Your Addis lawn has different needs during active growth, summer heat, and cooler weather. We adjust the treatments to those conditions, using nutrition when the grass can benefit.
Time feeding to active growth, address early weeds, and use preventive treatments at appropriate seasonal windows.
Adjust nutrition and weed control for heat, moisture, and turf response while monitoring seasonal insect activity.
Shift nutrition as growth slows, manage cool-season weed pressure, and watch for seasonal disease concerns.
Monitor lawn conditions and winter weeds. Dormant warm-season grass does not need the same nitrogen feeding as actively growing summer turf.
This is an overview of seasonal priorities. Actual products, rates, and visit timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.
Know the grass. Match the care.
Feeding more is not always the answer. We consider the turf, sunlight, moisture, and mowing so nutrition supports healthy growth and weed-control choices fit your grass.
Learn more: LSU AgCenter’s Louisiana Lawn Maintenance guide (PDF) and UF/IFAS centipedegrass guidance .
Local service for Addis homeowners

What to expect from the program, your monthly price, and the care your lawn receives.

No. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract. Your estimate explains the recommended service, price, and terms before you approve.

Your estimate is based on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean a treatment every month.

Yes. The program includes seasonal weed prevention and targeted control of existing weeds. We select products for your grass, weeds, and conditions. Persistent weeds can require ongoing management or additional targeted care, which we review with you.

Our regular lawn program uses liquid applications. Seasonal nutrition, micronutrients, and weed-control treatments are selected for the turf and conditions. Products are combined only when appropriate for the application and label directions.

We serve Addis, including Sugar Mill Plantation, and nearby communities such as Brusly, Port Allen, Plaquemine, Lobdell, and Erwinville. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm service availability and prepare pricing for your property.

features.title: Understand the lawn
features.body: Grass type, sunlight, moisture, and weeds help guide treatment. Tell us about thin areas, patches, or places that stay wet so we can consider what is holding the lawn back.

features.title: Apply with purpose
features.body: Our liquid program pairs seasonal nutrition with weed prevention and targeted control. Products and timing are selected for the grass, active problems, and application conditions.

features.title: Keep care responsive
features.body: We review the lawn’s response and monitor insect and disease concerns as the seasons change. Visit photos and notes explain the work and any watering, mowing, or other aftercare.

real_faqs.q: How often do you treat lawns in Addis?
real_faqs.a: Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Timing and applications depend on the season, weather, and turf condition. Each visit serves a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.
No. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract. Your estimate explains the recommended service, price, and terms before you approve.

real_faqs.q: How is lawn treatment priced and billed?
real_faqs.a: Your estimate is based on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean a treatment every month.

Yes. The program includes seasonal weed prevention and targeted control of existing weeds. We select products for your grass, weeds, and conditions. Persistent weeds can require ongoing management or additional targeted care, which we review with you.

real_faqs.q: Do you use liquid or granular fertilizer?
real_faqs.a: Our regular lawn program uses liquid applications. Seasonal nutrition, micronutrients, and weed-control treatments are selected for the turf and conditions. Products are combined only when appropriate for the application and label directions.

real_faqs.q: Which areas around Addis do you serve?
real_faqs.a: We serve Addis, including Sugar Mill Plantation, and nearby communities such as Brusly, Port Allen, Plaquemine, Lobdell, and Erwinville. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm service availability and prepare pricing for your property.

real_faqs.q: Do I need to be home, and how should I prepare?
real_faqs.a: Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and share any access restrictions or sensitive areas. We provide service notes and product-specific directions for watering, mowing, and other aftercare.

real_faqs.q: When can children and pets return to the lawn?
real_faqs.a: Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

real_faqs.q: Can I add fire ant, fungus, or tree and shrub care?
real_faqs.a: Fire ant and tree and shrub treatments are separate services we can discuss with your estimate. Seasonal insect and disease care follow the lawn program’s scope. Additional targeted treatments may have a separate price, which we explain before you approve.

real_faqs.q: Will fertilizer fix thin grass or bare spots?
real_faqs.a: Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.
